## Strongest current system statement

Fresh construction always returns in the Lean model. Under the stated
guard conditions, the constructed value represents exactly the intended
finite trees. A completed supported root reduction with empty inherited
constraints preserves that exact language. Initial field allocation,
validity, guard coverage and numeric resource conditions remain explicit.
General reduction completion and whole-library Haskell refinement remain
open. Read `notes-current-system-claim.md` for the exact contracts.

## New checked result

`SourceCurrentClassFoldStructuralOrigins.children` traces any descendant
structural row occurrence through an actual ordered forest scan. It keeps
the same forest index. It derives the physical support and native history
after each earlier selected child. `list` covers the literal list edit.
`class_sources` covers the actual compiled class and its captured forest.

`fold` composes these sources through the actual chronological class fold.
An output occurrence has an initial structural source in the same forest
slot, or an actual native leaf or Head event in an earlier class phase.
Each source preserves the symbol, full guard and arity. Child identity is
not asserted. The event retains an occurrence within its own value.
Its residual path need not be a suffix of the output occurrence path.
Actual child slices retain their ordered prefix, dispatch and suffix.
Actual completed tails derive the next class support and writer history.

`SourceCurrentActualClassFoldStructuralOrigins.fold` connects this result
to a literal bounded-worker return. Initial Frame, Fits and numeric
reservations derive its semantic read graph. The returned receipt retains
the final Frame, Fits and forest length. The caller does not supply desired
source ancestry or semantic reads. Initial physical memo support, coverage,
global validity and native writer history remain explicit. This theorem
also applies to an already completed tail. It does not require an enclosing
traversal to return.

The previous root-only `FoldFlow` cannot consume arbitrary descendant
`RowAt` occurrences. This result adds that descendant composition. It does
not assert `Required.Origin` across native joins or identify a later class
forest with the original Required input.

## Remaining mathematical gap

Structural occurrences do not by themselves explain observed rows after
Mu unfolding. A terminal read needs its actual recursive read interval.
A native event can also expose a constrained continuation. The original
false gate does not make that event value plain. The next producer must
retain the actual edit, projection and read continuation through these
events. A structural event value and row fields alone are insufficient.
The exact proposed producer and reused Mu exposure endpoints are recorded
in `restart-evidence/20261019-class-fold-structural/observational-projection-next-step.md`.

The global progress proof must then bound renewed constraint origins and
exclude active-owner repetition, including empty owners. No generated-child
mass decrease or ordinary-height decrease is asserted here. General outer
completion, repeated-pass convergence and Haskell refinement remain open.
